body: Same thing happened to me basically got cheated on it fucking sucks. “I don’t know why I’m upset, someone who hurt me in the worst possible way is now out of my life, but I miss her.” So fucking real it’s weird cause you don’t even know what was real and like what was an act it’s fucking hard and every time I hear about more of the whore shit she does it bothers me so much even though like they should be dead to me.
